steps.step: T1.1 reconstruction of the frozen h_W: Hermitian, support {0, +-b1, +-b2, +-b3} (three of the four mark directions), zeros exactly at Gamma and P, V_Gamma = I, V_P = -R_120 (orthogonal, det -1): two isotropic Weyl cones of opposite chirality; lowest free positive energies reproduce the published 1.4142 / 0.7174 / 0.7071 for V = 16 / 32 / 64
steps.detail: zero classes 2; lowest positive energies {'cubic16': np.float64(1.4142), 'oh32': np.float64(0.7174), 'prim64': np.float64(0.7071), 'debug4': np.float64(3.4641)}

steps.step: T1.2 microscopic point group of h_W: of the 48 elements of O_h (with spin rotation) exactly the three-element C3 about [111] survives

T1.3 MARK_C3_SELECTION: the four chart Hamiltonians h^(a) (mark a distinguished) are mapped onto each other by every mark rotation g in A4 with its spin lift, U_g h^(a)(g^-1 k) U_g^dag = h^(g a)(k) up to the cyclic relabelling of the three primitive directions (outcome A: chart equivalence); the surviving C3 is the stabiliser of the distinguished mark; the surface relation and the mark Clifford algebra treat all four marks alike, so nothing checked in P1/P2 selects one (outcome C for the selection)
steps.detail: A4 elements checked 12, stabiliser of mark 0: 3 elements

steps.step: T1.4 GAMMA_FACTOR: h_W(Gamma) = 0 and f(Gamma) = 0 on every P-compatible periodic cell, so all kinetic and HS matrices vanish on the 32 Gamma modes; Z_Theta = 2^32 Z_active at mu = 0 (Gamma observables analytic)
steps.detail: Gamma block removed analytically from QMC

steps.step: T1.5 hashes: structure_hash fixes h_W, F, B_A, interaction and symmetries; parameter_hash(g, beta, N_tau, V) varies independently (g scans do not change the architecture)

structure.h_W: t sigma.(B^-1 d(Bk)), d_i = sin p_i + cos p_{i+1} - 1, p = Bk
structure.B_A: standard Spin(10) 10-channel (C = Gamma1 Gamma3 Gamma5 Gamma7 Gamma9)
structure.symmetry: C3[111] x Spin(10) x Z4 x translations
